findings.passage: Beau’s stance on the integrity of our elections is clear: No illegal votes – period – but every legal Hoosier’s vote should count.
findings.note: Campaign priorities page, written in the third person in his campaign's name. The page is undated; it was fetched 2026-10-22. It speaks of election integrity in general and does not mention photo ID, mail-ballot ID or proof of citizenship.

findings.passage: As our next Secretary of State, Beau will protect and strengthen the security of our elections, while ensuring that every eligible Hoosier can participate freely and fairly in our democracy.
findings.note: Same campaign priorities page. General pledge on election security and access; names no specific ID rule.
